resources.string:
Native authentication foundation. Account access is checked with the server.
App data is excluded from Android backup and device transfer. Network communication requires HTTPS.
Sign in to connect your native companion account.
Complete registration through the web system.
Sign-in is currently unavailable. Contact the application provider.
Secure native storage is unavailable. Sign out to clear native authentication material.
The native session could not be verified. Access remains unavailable. Retry or sign out.
Account access could not be checked. Retry or sign out.
This account does not currently have supported access. Sign out to continue.
The authentication callback was invalid or expired. Sign out and try again.
Authentication did not complete. Sign out and try again.
Full administration is available in the web system.
Your registration exists and is waiting for administrator approval. Refresh your account status to check for updates.
Your registration was rejected. Native access is unavailable. Contact your administrator for assistance.
No registration was found for your verified account. Complete registration in the full web system, then return here and refresh your account status.
The browser has a separate sign-in session. Sign in there with the same Google account. Returning here does not automatically change account access.
No browser is available to open the web system.
